olivia_cs: FYI customer BlueCart reports their ingest pipeline started failing after last night's rollout. Their parser expects order_date as ISO8601 and order_id at top-level, but responses now have order_date as an integer and order_id nested under metadata. Example payload they sent: 

olivia_cs: ```json
{
  "metadata": { "order_id": "OC-90123" },
  "order_date": 1710000000,
  "items": { "line_0": { "sku": "A1", "qty": 2 }, "line_1": { "sku": "B2", "qty": 1 } }
}
```

olivia_cs: They say the parser used to get: `{"order_id":"OC-90123","order_date":"2024-01-08T14:00:00Z","items":[{...}]}` and now fails to map. :face_with_head_bandage:

deploy-bot: deployment "inference-stack" v2024.02.14 finished rollout at 1705119900; models: default -> redwood/convai-v3.2 (canary -> redwood/convai-v3.2-fix)

jasper_eng: can you paste the original API request + request_id and the exact model name from the response headers?

olivia_cs: request_id: rq_0b8f7c9a, sample curl: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer ${REDWOOD_KEY}" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"convai-v3.2","input":"Extract order JSON from this confirmation: <order email body>","max_tokens":512,"structured_output":true}'
```

olivia_cs: Response body they received (abbreviated): ```json
{
  "request_id":"rq_0b8f7c9a",
  "model":"convai-v3.2",
  "result": "{\"metadata\":{\"order_id\":\"OC-90123\"},\"order_date\":1710000000,\"items\":{\"line_0\":{\"sku\":\"A1\",\"qty\":2}}"
}
```

priya_support: They also said sometimes order_date appears as 1710000000000 (ms) and sometimes as 1710000000 (s) depending on the input. So consumer code that did a strict `new Date(order_date)` choked.

samir_ml: hypothesis: structured_output post-processing started stringifying the model's JSON output and we lost the array shape for `items` (model returned items as array but a later pass flattened keys like `line_0`). Could be a change in the fallback post-processor that flattens nested lists for token-limiting. Also the epoch-vs-iso problem: a formatting normalization step may have been toggled.

jasper_eng: logs for rq_0b8f7c9a show: `inference: model=convai-v3.2 variant=convai-v3.2-q4f, postproc:strict_json=true, array_normalizer=enabled, timestamp_normalizer=auto`

jasper_eng: that `array_normalizer` was introduced in last week's PR to reduce token count by converting small arrays into keyed lines. I think that broke backward compatibility.

samir_ml: if `strict_json=true` then we may be calling JSON.stringify on the model's raw returned structure rather than merging when model emits top-level object. That would explain `result` being a string which then gets parsed differently by different clients.

olivia_cs: customer says their SDK expects `result` to be parsed JSON (object) when structured_output=true. They rely on stable shapes across rollouts.

priya_support: action items: 1) rollback array_normalizer to off in prod, 2) add compatibility layer to coerce epoch ints to ISO strings when keys like order_date are detected, 3) mark incident and notify affected customers.

jasper_eng: I'll open a hotfix PR to disable array_normalizer and set `timestamp_normalizer=keep_iso` as default for structured_output routes, then trigger a quick canary on 5% traffic. Assigning to @jasper_eng.

samir_ml: also want an eval harness to detect shape/typing drift: run the structured-output test suite against convai-v3.2 and convai-v3.1 and compare typings for key prompts.

olivia_cs: customer asked for ETA on rollback. Can we do hotfix within 2 hours?

jasper_eng: yes, hotfix in 45-90m depending on rollout. I'll update thread when canary passes. :thumbsup:

priya_support: logging note: capture `structured_output` flag and `postproc` settings in the request trace so CS can triage faster next time.

olivia_cs: thanks—I'll message the customer with a temporary workaround: if they see `order_date` as int they can try `new Date(Number(order_date) * (order_date > 1e12 ? 1 : 1000))` until fix.

deploy-bot: rollback plan created: rollback id rb_2024_02_14_01, start at 1705124200 if approved.

jasper_eng: starting hotfix branch now.

olivia_cs: tagging customer account in support ticket #SC-8921 so they get notified when fixed.

samir_ml: follow-up: add a regression test to alert on type/shape changes in daily smoke runs.

olivia_cs: noted. Will add affected customers list to ticket.
